messages:
emma: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands re: sales pipeline & partners.
emma: Main asks: how to classify inbound trials, partner co-sell credit details, and a short Hosted vs Dedicated guidance for AEs.
raj: Classification: inbound trials = POC until signed PO or active subscription. Do not count toward commit.
nina: Partner pilot: approved 10% co-sell credit for registered partners for Q2. Registration via partner form in #partners. No retro credits.
caleb: Sales Ops will publish a simple calc sheet for co-sell credits and include it in the quote template.
sofia: Hosted first for quick TTV. Recommend Dedicated when customer needs data isolation, guaranteed throughput, or model pinning. I'll write a one-pager.
emma: Can someone draft a 1-line partner outreach pitch we can use in sequences?
raj: Draft pitch: "Redwood delivers predictable LLM inference — start on Hosted, move to Dedicated when you need SLA-backed throughput and data isolation." Short battlecard to follow.
caleb: Partner ops will run weekly office hours starting next Wed to handle registrations & questions.
partner-ops-bot: Partner registration form -> https://redwood.co/partners/register
emma: Recap actions: 1) Sofia: Hosted vs Dedicated one-pager; 2) Caleb/Sales Ops: calc sheet + quote template; 3) Partner Ops: office hours + registration tracking. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
nina: :white_check_mark: partner pilot doc published.
caleb: :white_check_mark: calc sheet and quote template shared in #sales.
sofia: :white_check_mark: one-pager posted to /docs/internal.
emma: Thanks all, closing thread.
